answer: Audits are entered in lantern, queued in relic, and timber publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 20 identities per epoch. A farm of 173 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2890 identities would post 4671 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
